business_problem: Customers needed trusted answers from Dun & Bradstreet's extensive business data without manually searching multiple products and datasets, and high-stakes questions required transparent reasoning and data lineage.
solution_summary: Dun & Bradstreet built ChatD&B as a conversational assistant that gives users real-time access to structured and unstructured business information. LangChain's agent framework connects language-model interactions to data blocks and traditional tools such as APIs, allowing the assistant to answer complex questions across business entities and domains including credit risk, sales, supply chain, and KYC. The system can explain which data informed an answer, while dynamic entitlements tailor access to users. LangSmith gives the data science team step-by-step traces, query comparisons, testing, and LLM-judge evaluation to improve groundedness and consistency. The source describes access to Dun & Bradstreet's curated business data but does not identify a specific model provider or disclose the retrieval and storage architecture.
